title: Catalog & Pricing

orderSources.title: Order channels
orderSources.subtitle: Control which sales channels are allowed for this tenant (mobile app, POS, integrations).
orderSources.defaultAllHelp: No explicit rules are stored yet: all active global channels are allowed.
orderSources.explicitListHelp: Only channels switched on below are allowed for new orders and public booking.
orderSources.remoteIntakeFlag: Uses remote booking flow until staff confirm garments at branch.

imageHint: JPEG / PNG / WebP, max 5 MB. Displayed on the order screen.
iconHint: Used as fallback when no image is uploaded. Example: 👔

preferences.title: Preferences Catalog
preferences.subtitle: Service and packing preferences for orders
preferences.servicePrefsDesc: Processing options: starch, perfume, delicate, etc.
preferences.packingPrefsDesc: Assembly options: hang, fold, box, etc.

dataGrid.emptyFilteredHint: Try checking your spelling or loosening your filters.

preferences.name: Name
preferences.preferenceKindsDesc: Configure which preference tabs show in the order panel
preferences.preferenceColorHint: #RRGGBB or blank to use catalog default
preferences.removeFromCatalogServiceDesc: Remove “{code}” from your catalog? It will no longer appear on new orders.
preferences.removeFromCatalogPackingDesc: Remove packing “{code}” from your catalog? It will no longer appear on new orders.
preferences.enablePreferenceHint: Saving adds this platform option to your tenant catalog so it appears on new orders.
preferences.preferenceKindsNote: Kind codes are defined by the platform. You can customize labels, colors, and visibility for your tenant.
preferences.catalogAddRowHint: To offer a platform option on new orders, open rows marked "Not in catalog" and click Add to catalog, or use the Not in catalog filter above.

speedPricing.title: Speed Pricing
speedPricing.subtitle: The premium added when a customer picks a faster service. With no matching rule, a faster speed costs the same as Standard.
speedPricing.newOrdersOnly: Applies to new orders and new edits only. Saved orders keep the price they were given.
speedPricing.priceTypeChangeHint: Changing the type clears the amount, because each type means something different.
speedPricing.multiplierExample: Example: 0.30 adds 30% to the normal price.
speedPricing.turnaroundHint: Optional. Hours to finish at this speed.
speedPricing.effectiveToHint: Leave empty if the rule has no end date.

order.title: When several rules match, the first one in this order wins:

empty.title: No speed rules yet
empty.description: With no rule, a faster speed adds no premium. Add a rule to charge for it.

validation.serviceSpeed: Choose a speed other than Standard.
validation.defaultSpeedSellPrice: Enter an amount with up to 4 decimals.
validation.multiplierSpeed: Enter a number with up to 4 decimals, such as 0.30.
validation.speedExtraAmount: Enter an amount with up to 4 decimals.
validation.priceBasis: Choose how the amount is charged.
validation.turnaroundHhSpeed: Enter hours with up to 2 decimals.
validation.effectiveTo: The end date cannot be before the start date.
validation.name: Use at most 200 characters.

errors.title: Could not complete this
errors.NOT_FOUND: This rule no longer exists. Refresh the list.
errors.DUPLICATE_SCOPE: A rule for this speed, scope and start date already exists. Edit that rule, or choose another start date.
errors.RULE_IN_USE: Orders were priced with this rule, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
errors.INVALID_REFERENCE: The speed, product, branch or category is no longer available. Choose another one.
errors.DISCOUNT_NOT_ALLOWED: Only a speed slower than Standard (Economy) can lower the price. Use a value of 0 or more for this speed.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some values are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: Your session needs refreshing. Reload the page and try again.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this rule?
deleteConfirm.description: This cannot be undone. The change stays in the price history.

bulk.title: Add rules for a category
bulk.description: Creates one rule for each active product in the category. A product that already has a rule for this speed, branch and start date keeps it. To cover the whole category with one rule, use Add rule instead.
bulk.done: {created, plural, one {# rule created} other {# rules created}}, {skipped} skipped.

resolver.title: Which rule applies?
resolver.noRule: No rule matches, so this speed adds no premium.

product.title: Speed pricing
product.description: The price of one unit of this product at each speed, for all branches. Changes apply to new orders only.
product.empty: This product has no rules of its own. Category and organization rules still apply.
product.saveFirst: Express and other speed prices are set after saving, in this form or in Speed Pricing. Until then, category and organization rules apply.

bulkStatus.title: Retire or restore product rules
bulkStatus.description: Acts on each product's own rules at this speed, at all branches. A retired rule stays on record and can be restored here. A rule for a category or for all products is not changed.
bulkStatus.previewRetire: {count, plural, =0 {No active product rules match.} one {# product rule will be retired.} other {# product rules will be retired.}}
bulkStatus.previewRestore: {count, plural, =0 {No retired product rules match.} one {# product rule will be restored.} other {# product rules will be restored.}}
bulkStatus.hasGeneralRule: These products will then follow the category or organization rule. Retail items do not follow a rule for all products.
bulkStatus.noGeneralRule: No active general rule covers these products, so at this speed they will cost the same as Standard. Add a rule for the category or all products first.
bulkStatus.restoreNote: This restores every retired product rule in this choice, including any retired one at a time.
bulkStatus.doneRetired: {count, plural, one {# rule retired.} other {# rules retired.}}
bulkStatus.doneRestored: {count, plural, one {# rule restored.} other {# rules restored.}}

taxCategory.label: Tax category
taxCategory.hint: Applies to new orders only. Orders already created keep their tax.

importAdvancedHint: Import adds new products only. price_express or express_multiplier (0.30 adds 30%) creates the product's Express rule in Speed Pricing; use one of them, not both. Leave both empty for no product rule.

importErrors.EXPRESS_PRICE_AND_MULTIPLIER: Use price_express or express_multiplier, not both.
importErrors.EXPRESS_VALUE_INVALID: The express price, multiplier or turnaround is not a valid number.
importErrors.EXPRESS_NEEDS_PERMISSION: Setting an express price needs the pricing:create permission.
importErrors.EXPRESS_RULE_NOT_SAVED: The product was created, but its express price was not saved. Add it in Speed Pricing.
importErrors.INVALID_TAX_CATEGORY: Tax category must be STANDARD, ZERO_RATED, EXEMPT or OUT_OF_SCOPE.
